title: FLAREr 3.9 (public release)
text: New optional da_setup fields: use_inflation_factor use_one_step_lag (decouples state parameter updates). New required add_random_noise field controlling process noise added. Optional log-space handling water-quality observations via log_transform_wq_obs log_transform_wq_zero_collapse avoid zero-clamping bias. title: FLAREr 3.9 (public release)
text: GLM-native restart support. Restart files now zip archives containing FLARE DA state (NetCDF) plus per-ensemble GLM restart files, rather plain NetCDF file. Old .nc restart files compatible 4.0. Requires GLM-AED version 4, adds NetCDF restart capacity feature depends . GLM-AED 4 currently available v4alpha branch GLM-AED can installed via GLMAEDr package: remotes::install_github("flare-forecast/GLMAEDr"). New restart_save_timesteps option output_settings controls timesteps (relative forecast_start_datetime) saved restart files.
